components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action available in a task state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:48px; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid #007E8C; border-radius:14px; background:#007E8C; color:#FFFFFF; font:600 14px/20px system-ui; } .ds-btn-primary:hover,.ds-btn-primary:active { background:#006674; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #A2E0E5; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A safe alternate action without competing with the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height:48px; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid #007E8C; border-radius:14px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#006674; font:600 14px/20px system-ui; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover,.ds-btn-secondary:active { background:#DDF8FB; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #A2E0E5; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: A destructive or safety-sensitive action that remains visually explicit.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height:48px; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid #C5364D; border-radius:14px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#C5364D; font:600 14px/20px system-ui; } .ds-btn-danger:hover,.ds-btn-danger:active { background:#FCECEF; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #F4C2C8; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: A low-emphasis text action for navigation or optional work.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { min-height:48px; padding:12px 16px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:14px; background:transparent; color:#006674; font:600 14px/20px system-ui; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover,.ds-btn-quiet:active { background:#DDF8FB; } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #A2E0E5; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: A labeled 52 dp field with a visible error contract.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#102A33; font:600 14px/20px system-ui; } .ds-field input { min-height:52px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid #CFE0E4; border-radius:14px; background:#F6FAFB; color:#102A33; font:400 16px/24px system-ui; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color:#007E8C; outline:2px solid #A2E0E5; } .ds-field small { color:#C5364D; font:400 13px/18px system-ui; }

components.name: State Panel
components.description: Truthful empty, error, or development context with one next action.
components.html:
Chưa có kết nối

Chỉ mutual like do máy chủ xác nhận mới mở trò chuyện.
components.css: .ds-state { padding:24px; border:1px solid #CFE0E4; border-radius:22px; background:#FFFFFF; color:#102A33; font-family:system-ui; } .ds-state h3 { margin:0 0 12px; font-size:22px; line-height:29px; } .ds-state p { margin:0; color:#587079; font-size:16px; line-height:24px; } .ds-state:focus-within { border-color:#007E8C; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.html: <nav class="ds-tabs"><button class="ds-tab-active">Khám phá</button><button>Đã lưu</button><button>Kết nối</button><button>Hồ sơ</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tabs { min-height:66px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); border-top:1px solid #CFE0E4; background:#FFFFFF; } .ds-tabs button { border:0; background:transparent; color:#587079; font:400 13px/18px system-ui; } .ds-tabs button:hover,.ds-tabs button:focus-visible { background:#DDF8FB; outline:none; } .ds-tabs .ds-tab-active { color:#006674; font-weight:600; }

components.name: Sync Line
components.description: A real loading, selection, or readiness indicator; never fabricated progress.
components.css: .ds-sync div { height:4px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:999px; background:#EAF3F5; } .ds-sync span { display:block; width:55%; height:100%; background:#007E8C; } .ds-sync small { display:block; margin-top:8px; color:#587079; font:400 13px/18px system-ui; }

narrative.overview:
HeartSync uses restrained cyan signals on cool, quiet surfaces. The interface names empty, unavailable, error, and development states instead of filling space with fake profiles or simulated success.

The Q01 implementation is code-verified only. Insets, keyboard behavior, large fonts, TalkBack, tablet/landscape layout, and perceived color remain pending Android-device review.
keyCharacteristics: Cool white and mist surfaces with one disciplined cyan accent.
Dark, readable text and explicit state copy.
Flat bordered containers instead of decorative card grids.
Native stack and four-destination bottom navigation.

rules.name: The Confirmed Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan is reserved for a real action, selection, readiness, or confirmed state; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Semantic State Rule
rules.body: Error states combine danger color with explanatory text, never color alone.

rules.name: The Direct Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Use a direct title and supporting body copy; do not manufacture hierarchy with repeated uppercase kickers.

rules.name: The Native Orientation Rule
rules.body: Navigation and Back behavior remain platform-native; branded surfaces must not replace orientation controls.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Do not add shadows unless a future interaction requires real elevation and a deliberate token is added.

dos: Do keep actions and explanations together within thumb reach.
Do preserve 48 dp minimum touch targets and native Back behavior.
Do use explicit empty, unavailable, error, and development copy.
Do prefer borders and tonal layering before introducing shadows.
donts: Don't claim authentication, profiles, matches, realtime activity, or calls before server confirmation.
Don't repeat uppercase kickers or use-case identifiers as the primary production hierarchy; the Q01 placeholder labels are temporary traceability aids.
Don't use cyan as ambient decoration or display fabricated Sync Line progress.
Don't treat device behavior as approved until Android smoke and accessibility tests are recorded.
